test_cases.name: SDK Fallback List NAT Gateways
test_cases.command: python3 -c "import os; from huaweicloudsdkcore.auth.credentials import BasicCredentials; from huaweicloudsdknat.v2.region.nat_region import NatRegion; from huaweicloudsdknat.v2 import NatClient, ListNatGatewaysRequest; c=NatClient.new_builder().with_credentials(BasicCredentials(os.getenv('HUAWEICLOUD_SDK_AK'),os.getenv('HUAWEICLOUD_SDK_SK'))).with_region(NatRegion.value_of('cn-north-4')).build(); r=c.list_nat_gateways(ListNatGatewaysRequest(limit=25)); print('SDK OK, gateways:', [g.name for g in (r.nat_gateways or [])])"
test_cases.expected: SDK returns the NAT gateway list
